lines: a ball of thread for making sounds with your agent
Every sound here comes out of an Ariadne World.

segments.title: GUITAR
segments.subtitle: Wayfaring Stranger, after Doc Watson · bars 1-4
segments.world: steel-string-v0 · 6 strings, a top, the air, a room
segments.caption: Each pluck travels string → bridge → top → air → room.
segments.why: The intro from the World at rest: alternating thumb, hammer-ons and pull-offs over six strings, ending on the bar-5 downbeat (A minor), faded over its first 0.38 s.

segments.title: PIANO
segments.subtitle: Prelude in C major, BWV 846 (J. S. Bach) · the opening
segments.world: piano-v1 · felt hammers, stiff wires, dampers, a ribbed soundboard
segments.caption: Felt hammers strike stiff wires; the soundboard does 99.98 % of the radiating.
segments.why: The opening of the Ariadne piano's demo score (bars 1-2 and half of bar 3, from the first strike), faded over 0.4 s.

segments.title: TROMBONE
segments.subtitle: solo, third phrase · up to partial 10, out to position 7
segments.world: trombone v1 · one N-D body: bore, slide, lips, lungs
segments.caption: The slide is a coordinate of the World; the lips are a valve the lungs pay for.
segments.why: The solo's climax: a scoop into F4, a rip to C5 (partial 10), tongued triplets, smears down to position 5, then the next phrase's smear out to position 7.

segments.title: PINK TROMBONE
segments.subtitle: a vocal tract, after Neil Thapen's Pink Trombone (2017)
segments.world: ovillo-tract-world · lungs, folds, tongue, velum, lips, nose
segments.caption: The tongue, lips, velum and folds move the World; the lungs pay for every sound.
segments.gaps: gaps: no aspiration noise, one jet
segments.why: One scripted take through the page's own controls: /a/, a lip closure (pa), /i/, /u/, a nasal (ma), a voiceless alveolar hiss.
